title: Governed HTTP error (live-check-v1)
description: JSON errors on the two mounted paths, including method errors but not the fallback for unmounted paths or transport errors. For each code, x-http-status gives the required HTTP status outside the JSON body.

oneOf.description: JSON extraction fails (including content type, syntax, type/unknown fields or body size), or the parsed limit is outside 1–100.
The query is empty, violates the planner limits or is rejected by the lexical parser.
No valid bearer capability was supplied, including a rejected identity, signature, audience, time bound or replay.
The authenticated capability fails the tenant, action, resource or signed-limit admissibility checks.
The valid request limit exceeds the signed max_limit.
The method is not mounted on this path; on /v0/search the capability is verified first.
An unexpected search task, index, or response-construction failure prevents returning results.
An effective signed resource is unsearchable, or availability fails globally without signed indexes.
The verifier task failed or could not use or durably update replay protection.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic that does not quote caller-supplied search input. Branch on status and code, not message wording.
